summary: Resubmitting the previously validated update unchanged (the last turn failed only on response formatting). It adds a minimal StopSign-resync witness to the draft harness and executes test `decided_stopsign_only_decide_is_resent`. The test elects node 1 with a 1000-tick election timeout so leadership cannot change, decides entries 1..2 on all five nodes, then reconfigures while discarding both the AcceptStopSign addressed to node 5 and the leader's first Decide to it. Event `ready` records node 5's admission premise (accepted 2, decided 2, promised to the leader) before the loss; event `after_resend` records, after 150 ticks with every message delivered, node 5's accepted/decided/leader/promise state plus the leader's decided index, `decision_gap`, and counts of Decide/Prepare/AcceptSync/AcceptStopSign messages sent to node 5 with the last Decide sequence counter. The declared comparison asserts `decision_gap == 0` for admitted runs in which at least one Decide reached node 5, so a clamped resend yields a violated complete comparison, while a sequence-break recovery would show Prepare/AcceptSync traffic and a closed gap. Two sources were registered to support the expected mechanism: the sequence-status check in util.rs and the follower's sequence handling in follower.rs.
